- Multiplying 3/20 by 200 gives (3 × 200) / 20 = 600 / 20 = 30.

Alternatively, 10% of 200 is 20, and 5% of 200 is 10, so 15% is 20 + 10 = 30.

Thus, 15% of 200 is 30.
